browserPermissions.deleteDescription: Removing this site's memory will prompt you again on its next request.

displayCapture.description: This site can capture your screen or a window.

clipboardRead.label: Clipboard read
clipboardRead.description: This site can read content copied to your clipboard.

fileSystem.label: File access
fileSystem.description: This site can access your local file system.

midi.description: This site can connect to your MIDI devices.

fullscreen.description: This site can enter fullscreen mode.

inputLock.label: Input lock
inputLock.description: This site can capture your mouse pointer and keyboard input.

idleDetection.description: This site can detect when you are active or idle.

windowManagement.label: Window placement
windowManagement.description: This site can control window position and size.

speakerSelection.description: This site can choose your audio output device.

themeDescription.github-dark: GitHub's official dark. Calm teal and blue accents, fairly low saturation
themeDescription.github-light: GitHub's official light. White background, dark text — WCAG AA
themeDescription.dracula: The legendary purple and pink dark. Vivid saturation built on an 8-color palette
themeDescription.one-dark-pro: The VS Code port of Atom One Dark. Balanced saturation, the safest dark
themeDescription.monokai: The Sublime Text classic. Vivid magenta, cyan and yellow
themeDescription.tokyo-night: Cool blue-violet. Calm and modern, one of the most popular lately
themeDescription.solarized-dark: Ethan Schoonover's classic. Even CIE lightness that is easy on the eyes
themeDescription.nord: Arctic and north-bluish. Known for its restrained 16-color palette
themeDescription.catppuccin-mocha: A calm pastel dark. Mocha is the darkest of the four flavors
themeDescription.gruvbox-dark: Retro groove. Warm brown, olive and mustard tones

shell.label: Default shell
shell.missingFallback: This shell can't be found, so terminals open with the system default.
shell.listHint: Added shells can be the default shell, or opened from the tab bar's + › New Terminal With.
shell.name: Name
shell.programNotFound: No program with this path or name was found.
shell.hint: Applies to terminals opened from now on. SSH workspaces use the remote server's login shell.

taskAgent.label: Task agent command
taskAgent.hint: A new task's terminal runs this, with the task's first prompt as its argument. Leave it empty to run nothing.

ligatures.description: Renders multi-character sequences like =>, !=, >= as single glyphs when the font supports it. Applies to terminal programs (shells, TUIs) too.

terminal.fontNotFound: Not found on this system — the preview will use the fallback font.

osEnabled.label: Show desktop notifications
osEnabled.description: When Claude needs your attention (response complete, permission request, or a notification hook), the app surfaces an OS-level desktop notification — but only while you are not viewing that tab. In-app indicators (sidebar attention dot, response preview) remain regardless.

enabled.label: Let agents use the nexus command
enabled.description: Agents in the app's terminals (Claude Code, Codex, ...) can run nexus to see other workspaces' terminals and sessions, open files, diffs, terminals and browser tabs, and type into other terminals. Off, every nexus command fails.

crossWorkspace.label: Changes to other workspaces
crossWorkspace.description: What nexus may change in a workspace other than its terminal's own: open tabs, type into terminals, close tabs. Reading other workspaces is always allowed.

agentContext.label: Tell Claude Code about nexus
agentContext.description: Claude Code sessions started in the app get a short note on nexus when they start, so they know they can use it. Codex is not told; add a line to its AGENTS.md if you want it to.

consent.title: Allow an agent to change another workspace?
consent.description: The terminal "{{tab}}" in {{from}} asks to {{action}} in {{to}}.
consent.timeout: It is turned down if not answered in {{seconds}} seconds.

action.browserControl: click, type or run scripts in the browser tab "{{detail}}"

autoCheck.label: Automatically check for updates
autoCheck.description: Fire one silent GitHub Releases check at app startup. Manual checks below always run regardless of this setting.

about.storeManaged: Updates come from the Microsoft Store.

section.editorDescription: Monaco editor commands — active only while the editor is focused. Changing one twice in a session may need an app restart to fully settle.

editorCommand.addSelectionToNextFindMatch: Add Selection to Next Find Match

record.promptSecond: Press the second key of the chord
record.hint: Enter to save · Esc to cancel

languageServers.description: Completion, go to definition and error checking. Click a language's name in the status bar to see its server.
languageServers.installedDescription: Left empty, the server is looked for on the PATH and where its installer puts it. Remote workspaces look on their host.
languageServers.lowMemoryDescription: Uses about 40% less memory; the first answer comes a little later.
languageServers.maxWorkspacesDescription: Beyond this, the servers of the workspace used least recently stop first.
